t: You're in Philbeach Gardens, a communal garden square in Earl's Court, in the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea. Two people are recorded as having died here. Richard John Mahony, who lived from 1828 to 1892, was a landlord, writer and evangelical preacher. Murrell Robinson Robinson, who lived from 1821 to 1900, was an engineer and surveyor. I don't have more on the square's history, so I'll leave it there.
